text:
[Council File 26-1427]
Motion (Rodriguez – Padilla, et al.) relative to establishing a Citywide data privacy policy and supporting policies with standards and safeguards governing data collection, storage, retention, access, sharing, disclosure, cybersecurity, and protection of individual privacy.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion to establish a citywide data privacy policy, with supporting standards and safeguards for how city data is collected, stored, kept, accessed, shared and secured, and for protecting individual privacy.
